“You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.
When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and…
For Yahweh says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.
“But even in those days,” says Yahweh, “I will not make a full end of you.
But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
What do you plot against Yahweh? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.

translations.web: Nevertheless my eye spared them, and I didn’t destroy them. I didn’t make a full end of them in the wilderness.
translations.bsb: Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or bring them to an end in the wilderness.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.
translations.asv: Nevertheless mine eye spared them, and I destroyed them not, neither did I make a full end of them in the wilderness.
